# Test fixtures

All data in this directory is synthetic. No file describes a real person.

## synthea/

Five C-CDA R2.1 documents generated by [Synthea](https://github.com/synthetichealth/synthea)
(synthetichealth/synthea, Apache License 2.0). They were taken unmodified from the
published sample set `synthea_sample_data_ccda_sep2019.zip`. The patients, providers,
identifiers and clinical events in them are generated by Synthea's simulation and are not
derived from any real record.

The slow smoke test (`pytest -m slow`) runs the whole sample set when it is present. Point
`HRB_SYNTHEA_DIR` at a directory holding the extracted XML files to enable it; the test is
skipped otherwise.

## handwritten/

`mychart_like_ccd.xml` is written by hand for this project. It mimics the shape of an Epic
MyChart "Download my record" Continuity of Care Document so the converter can be exercised
on features the Synthea set never produces: allergy reactions and severity, medication
orders with route and frequency, lab reference ranges and interpretation codes, encounter
locations and performers, immunization lot numbers and refusals, and a populated Social
History section. Every name, identifier, address and value is fictional.

## epic/

`mychart_epic_synthetic.xml` is a real Epic MyChart "Download my record" document whose
identity, demographics, identifiers, Epic customer OIDs and all clinical content were replaced
by `hrb synthesize`, run three times with seeds that are not published. Only Epic's structure
remains: its section set and order, entry templates, organizers, narrative references and
Epic-local code systems. Every name, id, date and clinical value in it is made up. See
`epic/README.md`. It is in the shared fixture list and tested in detail in
`test_epic_fixture.py`; the shared entry-count check skips it, because Epic leaves some
result observations with a null code and no text, which the converter drops.

## xdm/

`mychart_export_letha284.zip` wraps one of the Synthea documents in the IHE XDM folder layout
that MyChart emits (`MachineReadable_XDMFormat/IHE_XDM/SUBSET01/DOC0001.XML` plus stub
`INDEX.HTM`, `README.TXT` and `METADATA.XML`). It is used to check that archive input
yields the same bundle as the bare XML.
